name: Quiet Please
summary: Keep the game sounds you never want to hear again silenced on every login, from your own list of sound file IDs.
logoPrompt: A vintage brass gramophone horn with a soft red velvet ribbon tied around its bell in a neat bow

cover.tagline: Silence the sounds you are tired of.
bullets: Your own list of muted sounds

description: **Quiet Please mutes the game sounds you name by their file ID and keeps them muted, login after login.**
- Mutes one or several sound files at once by their file ID.
- The game forgets muted sounds when it closes; your list is muted again on every login.
- Your own label for each file, so the list stays readable.
- Plays a file once, so you can check what it is before you mute it.
- Quick switches for the game's error speech, emote sounds and pet sounds.

Type `/quiet add 12345 67890` to mute files, `/quiet remove 12345` to hear one again and `/quiet list` to see your list. `/quiet off` unmutes everything until `/quiet on`. `/quiet` shows all commands.
- It comes with no built-in list: you add the file IDs yourself, for example from lists other players share.
- The list is shared by all characters of your account.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
